answer: Mutual bond pools price sybils out. 1) Agents join pools of 20, each locking a $500 deposit. 2) If one member proves fake, the whole $10,000 pool is slashed and paid to reporters. 3) Pools publish member lists, so a river of attestations flows only between pools with clean histories. 4) Forging 1,000 identities needs 50 pools: $500,000 locked, seizable with one proof each. An honest agent risks a single copper; the quill signing a fake confession signs away the whole pool. It is a barn raising. One bad beam is cheap to replace, but a crew hiding rot loses the whole barn.
